whatItDoes: Runs a side question asynchronously in its own Pi child session and returns the result to the parent transcript.
Uses fresh context by default, with an explicit fork mode that snapshots the current persisted parent branch.
Limits child inspection to Pi's read, grep, find, and ls tools; no shell or file-mutation tool is exposed to the child.

whenToReachForIt.invocation: Run /btw with a question; add --fork only when the side question needs the current persisted branch.

situations.when: A small question should not redirect the main conversation
situations.use: Ask it in a fresh child session and keep the parent workflow focused.

situations.when: The answer depends on decisions already recorded in the current branch
situations.use: Use fork mode to give the child a point-in-time branch snapshot.

situations.when: Several read-only investigations can run independently
situations.use: Queue side questions and inspect generic status or cancel by run prefix.

whatItAdds: A bounded queue for asynchronous side questions.
Fresh and forked context modes with per-run child sessions.
Durable result cards plus a compact active-work widget.

howItFits.relationship: BTW handles short read-only side questions; Pi Subagents covers broader delegated workflows and configurable child execution.

questions.question: Is the read-only child a filesystem sandbox?
answer: No. Its tool list excludes shell and mutation tools, but read-oriented tools can inspect paths available to the Pi process.
Use operating-system or container isolation when code running under the same account is not trusted.

questions.question: What persists after a run?
answer: The terminal result is appended to the parent session as a transcript entry.
Child session artifacts are temporary and cleanup is guarded and best effort; abnormal failure can leave private temporary data for later cleanup.

questions.question: What does fork mode include?
answer: It copies only the persisted parent ancestry through the leaf captured at invocation, not later parent updates.

workingIf: Accepted questions appear as queued, starting, or running without replacing the parent turn.
A completed side question appears as a durable result card.
Fresh runs have no parent transcript, while forked runs use the captured branch snapshot.
setupNotes: Requires interactive Pi and an available selected model through Pi's provider runtime.
The package itself runs with host-process access even though its child tool inventory is read-only.
